name: dayflow-hrms
description: DAYFLOW HRMS — Human Resource Management System Monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,blue.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
